author: Amal Kumar

ground_normal_gl.webp.processing: Original OpenGL PNG decoded to RGB8, Lanczos resized to 512, per-texel vectors renormalized and explicitly rounded to nearest RGB8 integers, lossless WebP. No gamma transform or green flip. Original 1024 representation remains preserved; albedo and ARM are not repeated.

packed_channels.blue: metallic (factor zero, as in provider glTF)

material.normal: OpenGL tangent normal. No green flip or gamma transform.
material.mapping: World-space triplanar scale 0.5; two metres per repeat.
material.mipmaps: Generated once per shared image. Normal mipmaps use vector renormalization.
material.geometry: No source displacement is applied. Shared terrain and collision geometry are unchanged.

preparation.albedo: 1024px RGB8 WebP quality 0.70, no resize or color transform. Measured sRGB RMSE against provider JPG: 0.0239971549899424; declared bound 0.025.
preparation.arm: Provider PNG decoded to RGB8, Lanczos resized to 512, lossless WebP. Decoded output equals the prepared scalar image.
preparation.normal: Provider 16-bit OpenGL PNG decoded to RGB8, Lanczos resized to 512, vectors normalized and explicitly rounded to nearest RGB8, lossless WebP. Decoded output equals prepared bytes; maximum unit-length error 0.0065264105796814.
preparation.retained_alternatives: The valid 1024px normal exceeds the combined source allowance. The first 512px writer failed its unit-vector bound; both outputs and results remain external.

limits: Source packaging and headless material tests do not establish rendered quality, Satisfactory parity or GPU cost.
